acceptance: Reproduce silent no-op behavior with missing App credentials and assert detector failure; valid pending/failure/success review outcomes count as posted, but missing results do not.

Bind proof to the exact target head and expected review App/context. A pre-existing or stale status, wrong head, or unrelated writer must not satisfy a new invocation. Explicitly distinguish legitimate skips (draft/out-of-scope/stale event/non-command comment) from a job that was required to post.
The downstream detector runs even when the reusable job fails or is skipped, with explicit upstream result and documented skip handling; it must never turn a missing required review into green.

Prove negative secret-omission and positive trivial/known-defect/docs-only scenarios without broadening oracle environment deployment or required-check settings. Branch dispatch is prohibited by current policy. Use hermetic pre-merge execution of the real detector and publish an owner-approved canary sequence on develop after merge, or obtain explicit owner approval for a different live pre-merge method. Record exact heads and run URLs; a known-defect verdict can post correctly while its gate remains red.
context:
Serial item (not a batch member). Start after the release-v2-remediation final PR merges, since rv2r-07 and rv2r-14 edit review-gate.yml in the batch. review-verdict and review-gate run on pull_request_target, so caller edits only run after merge unless dispatched with --ref; use dispatch for all pre-merge evidence. A false red blocks every merge, so canary first. DECISION GATE: any change needing repository or environment settings (secrets, rulesets, required checks) goes to the owner.

TODO review 2026-11-08: original acceptance demands branch dispatches that both the reusable guard and develop-only oracle environment refuse (review guide lines 142-149). Replaced that impossible criterion with policy-preserving hermetic checks plus explicit post-merge live evidence; any different pre-merge deployment path requires an owner decision. Existing uncommitted detector work found in BenchBox.wt-review-detector; do not duplicate or adopt those edits without coordination. Settings/required checks remain owner-only.
description: After #3942 the oracle verdict caller ran without secrets, posted nothing, and its jobs still went green. Since the Theseus v0.2 migration (#3962) the callers are .github/workflows/review-verdict.yml and .github/workflows/review-gate.yml. Add a final job to each that fails when no verdict (review-verdict) or gate status (review-gate) was posted for the head SHA, or have Theseus expose an output the caller asserts (change Theseus by its own PR and bump the pin per rv2r-07's procedure). Detectors only add failure conditions; they never relax or skip an existing check. Split from rv2r-06 on 2026-11-06 because these files fall outside the release-v2-remediation batch's frozen scopes; delivered serially after that batch's final PR merges. Rollback: revert the PR.
